### How fast are InspectMind plan check results?


Small checks often return around an hour; 100-500 page projects usually complete in a few hours, and larger 500+ page sets are usually same day. Every finding includes evidence: the specific drawing, code section, or spec reference.


### How much does InspectMind cost?


Plan checks start at $50 per run with per-sheet pricing for larger sets. Eligible work-email signups can apply a first-check credit. See pricing at https://www.inspectmind.ai/pricing.
